text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: What a tremendous race that was, Maruzensky!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the "Supercar"!
Congrats on 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Thanks to everyone's cheers,
I was able to run my absolute best race!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna blaze through in first place next race too,
so cheer for me, 'kay?♪"
(WAHAHAHA!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Why are you laughing...!?
Is "presh to meetcha" not trendy right now!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-kun!
Total and complete victory!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-chan!
Total and complete victory!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, did you fall in love
with my running too?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, did even you end up
falling in love with my running?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Still, it's thanks to Rudolf that we were able to run such an incredible race."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run right alongside you
and feel that "absolute" running power of yours even more~

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "That works out perfectly for us as well."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky, that was a splendid run.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you!
Your run was amazing too!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You said to your juniors, "I will show them
a back to look up to," but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To think that even I would be shown such a sight...
A back that makes you just want to chase after it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
One day, let us run together upon the turf again.
Next time, it'll be my turn to show you my back.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I accept your challenge.
Let us keep running, together as rivals.
And so, having conquered the race against Symboli Rudolf, the next goal was the Yasuda Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So that's Maruzen-san's running style right now...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That... was incredible, wasn't it...
